title: The scroll is a signal race

direction.audience_sees: A wide phone-shaped window is flooded by competing colored signals until one clean path cuts through them.
direction.hook: The opening visual makes the question of attention concrete before the narration finishes.
direction.value: Attention is won by giving the next moment a useful promise, not by maximizing noise.
direction.visual_approach: Original motion-graphic environment with a phone frame, signal particles, and one coral focal marker that steadies the frame.
direction.background: Near-black navy with faint scanlines and restrained grain-like dots.
direction.sound: Clean voice-led opening with no music; a subtle visual pulse can punctuate the hook.
direction.progression: Chaos compresses into one readable question and hands the focal marker into Scene 2.

direction.audience_sees: A split-screen shows a bold number, a contrast, and a question card orbiting an incomplete ring; the ring closes only partially.
direction.hook: The viewer sees exactly how a question can create forward motion without hiding the subject.
direction.value: A hook is an immediate reason to continue, and it must make a promise the explanation can fulfill.
direction.visual_approach: Three concise hook examples appear as visual objects, then become an open-to-closed curiosity ring.
direction.background: Navy field with coral question marks and paper-white labels.
direction.sound: Let the line about a promise breathe before the next chapter.
direction.progression: The incomplete ring becomes a rising chart for controlled revelation.

direction.audience_sees: An unlabeled line climbs, then labels and a comparison panel reveal in ordered steps; the audience can follow the chart before seeing its conclusion.
direction.hook: The mechanism is shown as a reveal sequence rather than a static data dump.
direction.value: Give enough context to follow the story while reserving one meaningful piece for the next beat.
direction.visual_approach: Wide chart and side-by-side panels, with amber bars building one at a time and an eye cursor guiding the gaze.
direction.background: Subtle grid, teal axis lines, amber data, coral unresolved marker.
direction.sound: A steady explanatory passage; no effects required.
direction.progression: The eye cursor travels along the chart and becomes the focus indicator in Scene 4.

direction.audience_sees: Three miniature examples transform: a bar grows, two blocks align, and a path draws from cue to response.
direction.hook: The same palette and motion vocabulary demonstrate quantity, comparison, and sequence.
direction.value: Animation works best when the movement represents the relationship the viewer needs to understand.
direction.visual_approach: Three-column visual grammar board with large, slow enough transformations and concise labels.
direction.background: Navy with three illuminated zones connected by a teal thread.
direction.sound: A crisp transition into the three examples, then a settled hold on the complete grammar board.
direction.progression: The three columns collapse into modular tiles for the cognitive-load chapter.

direction.audience_sees: A dense paragraph-like block breaks into four tiles: cue, response, consequence, change.
direction.hook: The audience watches difficulty reduce without the idea being erased.
direction.value: Simplicity is staging nuance one relationship at a time, not deleting nuance.
direction.visual_approach: A tactile modular diagram with one highlighted tile per beat and a persistent overview rail.
direction.background: Soft navy gradient with amber tile edges and teal connective lines.
direction.sound: Calmer cadence to let the distinction register.
direction.progression: Tiles settle into a consistent grid, leading to visual fluency.

direction.audience_sees: A visual key locks teal to explanation, coral to attention, and amber to progress; a noisy version simplifies into a fluent system.
direction.hook: The same idea looks easier when the design stops making the viewer decode it.
direction.value: Hierarchy, color meaning, repeated shapes, and spacing let the design become almost invisible.
direction.visual_approach: Before-and-after composition: crowded symbols on the left, disciplined visual system on the right, joined by a simplifying wipe.
direction.background: Clean navy with a bright paper-white baseline and restrained accent lights.
direction.sound: Brief pause on the phrase visual fluency.
direction.progression: The color key becomes three channels—voice, visual, captions—in Scene 7.

direction.audience_sees: A central mechanism diagram is surrounded by a voice waveform, a visual pointer, and a caption rail; each channel carries a different layer.
direction.hook: The audience can see why captions are not just duplicated narration.
direction.value: The voice interprets, the visual demonstrates, and the caption preserves access.
direction.visual_approach: Triangular composition with separate roles and an example sentence that appears only in the caption rail.
direction.background: Navy with teal waveform, coral pointer, amber caption underline.
direction.sound: Voice remains primary; visual accents are silent.
direction.progression: The waveform resolves into a progress line of small rewards.

direction.audience_sees: A route of nodes alternates between question and clarity; each resolved node lights briefly before the next opens.
direction.hook: Retention is reframed as progress through discoveries rather than endless suspense.
direction.value: The useful rhythm is tension, clarity, then the next related question.
direction.visual_approach: A horizontal progress route with a small chart completion, pattern recognition, and resolved insight as visual rewards.
direction.background: Near-black navy with a gentle amber trail and no busy transitions.
direction.sound: Let each sentence land against a completed node.
direction.progression: The route ends at a familiar phone-checking situation.

direction.audience_sees: A person-shaped outline tries to focus while a phone notification card enters the frame; the abstract attention diagram snaps onto the everyday scene.
direction.hook: A concrete situation replaces an abstract word like attention.
direction.value: Recognizable objects help viewers imagine themselves inside the explanation and make a takeaway more shareable.
direction.visual_approach: Simple illustrated desk vignette with notification, task card, and attention beam; no stock footage.
direction.background: Warm navy vignette with coral notification and teal focus beam.
direction.sound: A small breath before the ethical turn.
direction.progression: The focus beam meets a calibrated scale in Scene 10.

title: Attention is not permission to mislead

direction.audience_sees: A dramatic chart stretches toward a huge claim, then a calibration frame brings the scale back to proportion; evidence, qualifier, and fear separate visibly.
direction.hook: The ethical limit is visualized as a boundary the design must not cross.
direction.value: A strong hook needs proportional evidence; a possibility is not a universal law.
direction.visual_approach: Measured scale, warning boundary, and a red claim card corrected into an honest qualified statement.
direction.background: Navy darkens, coral warning is used sparingly, teal returns as the correction lands.
direction.sound: Serious but not alarmist; keep the correction clear.
direction.progression: The calibrated scale folds into the six-step blueprint.

direction.audience_sees: Six labeled steps assemble into one clean route: hook, context, proof, reveal, payoff, next action. The route settles into a final statement.
direction.hook: The opening question is answered with a usable production blueprint.
direction.value: The best infographic reels guide the eye, reduce confusion, and make a few seconds feel complete.
direction.visual_approach: Wide final route with numbered nodes, a calm final hold, and a precise takeaway card.
direction.background: Deep navy with the full accent palette now in balance; no visual clutter.
direction.sound: Warm, settled ending with room for the final sentence and hold.
direction.progression: Leave the blueprint fully visible on the exact final frame.
